children: Doehner Cobian Mauricio, an officer serving as EVP Corporate Affairs, reported a sale of Ordinary Participation Certificates represented by ADS. The reported weighted average price was $9.5705 per ADS, with individual ADS sale prices ranging from $9.570 to $9.575. The total sale amount reported was $8,880,466. After the transaction, the reporter directly owned 584,930 Ordinary Participation Certificates.
